data.name: Sharv
data.gender_notes: Sharv is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who rules or governs, a lord or ruler. In Hindu mythology, Sharv is an alternate name for Shiva, the god of destruction and transformation. The name Sharv carries the meaning “Ruler, Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharv usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power to rule over one's own thoughts and emotions, and to govern the forces of the universe.
data.etymology: Sharv belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler, Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharv total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

This name, therefore, carries a sense of strength and leadership, inspiring those who bear it to rule their own lives with courage and wisdom.
